svg.title: Four cells, and every metric is a ratio of them
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Four cells, and every metric is a ratio of them” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A two-by-two confusion matrix with TN 11, FP 3, FN 2 and TP 4, with a yellow highlighter swipe along the bottom row for recall (4 over 6) and down the right column for precision (4 over 7), beside a struck-out first attempt with the axes swapped; below, three bar pairs at falling fraud prevalence where ROC-AUC stays flat near 0.96 while precision at ninety percent recall collapses from 0.8418 to 0.0110; and at the foot a measured precision-recall curve with three operating points marked on it - the 0.5 default at recall 0.60 costing GBP 22,480, the F1-maximising 0.0693 at recall 0.77 costing GBP 13,080, and the cost-optimal 0.0221 at recall 0.82 costing GBP 10,180 - falling off a cliff to 0.011 precision at 0.90 recall.
svg.text: Four cells, and every metric is a ratio of them
draw it from memory, then compare
